description: Use when you need falsifiable, dated predictions about AI engineering: New Runtime's forecast ledger (claim, probability, due date, source analysis, topics). Narrow it with query (words over the claim, signpost, resolution criteria and source title; word forms match) and/or topic (a topic slug such as mcp or coding-agents, or a system); page with limit (at most 50) and offset (pass next_offset). matched counts the forecasts that pass the filter, count the whole ledger. Forecasts are graded when due; the scorecard (hit rate, Brier score) stays empty until the first ones resolve, and the result says when that is. Free, no auth. Example: {"status": "open", "query": "agent protocol", "topic": "mcp", "limit": 10}.

offset.description: Skip this many matching forecasts: the next_offset of the previous call.

query.description: Words to look for in the claim, signpost, resolution criteria and source title; every word must match (word forms match). When no forecast has every word, forecasts with the most matching words are returned and match says "any".

topic.description: Topic slug or name (topics of the source analysis), or a system (openclaw, hermes).

name: get_forecasts

counts_by_status.description: Counts for open, confirmed, refuted, unclear.

hint.description: When nothing matched: what to try.

match.description: all when every query word matched; any when no forecast had them all and the most matching words come first; null without a query.

next.description: How to see the rest, when more follow.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page.

query.description: The query as given, when one was given.

routes.description: HTML, JSON and Markdown routes of the ledger.

scorecard.description: Resolved and graded counts, hit rate and Brier score (null until graded).

status.description: Status filter: open, resolved or all.

topic.description: Topic or system filter, when one was given.

track_record.description: While nothing is graded: when the first forecast is due.

title: Read the New Runtime forecast ledger
